attributes.name: Mark of Divinity
attributes.description: You bear a faint scent of divinity, as though someone briefly touched by it once, a long time ago.

attributes.name: Child of Shadows
attributes.description: Shadows recognize you as one of their own.

attributes.name: Spark of Divinity
attributes.description: Every fire starts from a spark. Somewhere deep within your soul, a radiant spark shines with divine light.

attributes.name: Blood Weave
attributes.description: You have inherited a part of Weaver's forbidden lineage. Your blood has been altered and embued with odd tenacity.

attributes.name: Stalwar
attributes.description: This armor provides extremely high protection against physical attacks, high protection against elemental attacks, and a moderate amount of protection against mind and soul attacks.

attributes.name: Prince of the Underwolrd
attributes.description: This armor grows stronger according to the amount of opponents its wielder defeats.

attributes.name: Bone Weave
attributes.description: You have inherited a part of Weaver's forbidden lineage. Your bones have been altered and imbued with steadfast temperance…

aspect.name: Shadow Slave
aspect.description: You are a miraculous shadow left behind by a dead god. As a divine shadow, you possess plenty of strange and wondrous powers. However, your existence is empty and lonesome; you mourn the passing of your former master and long to find a new one.

abilities.name: Shadow Control
abilities.description: Your shadow is more independent than most. It is an invaluable helper.

abilities.name: Shadow Step
abilities.description: You can move freely between shadows, traveling from one to another in an instant.

abilities.name: Shadow Control
abilities.description: Your shadow is more independent than most. It is an invaluable helper.

abilities.name: Shadow Step
abilities.description: You can move freely between shadows, traveling from one to another in an instant.

abilities.name: Shadow Manifestation
abilities.description: You can manifest shadows as tangible objects

legacy.name: Shadow Dance
legacy.description: Once an elegant dance, now a deadly battle art. This mysterious style was created by the treacherous Lost From Light after witnessing a graceful slave dancing with her shadows. Who else could have taken something so beautiful and turned it into something so vile?

attributes.name: Fated
attributes.description: You have inherited a part of Weaver's forbidden lineage. Your soul has been altered and imbued with stalwart potency. A lonely demon shed tears standing above a forgotten grave. A tree grew from the ground where the demon's tears fell, and from it grew a wondrous fruit.
